methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: this paper focuses on the sustainable energy performance criteria, their effects to improve the sustainability of building energy and implementation possibility

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Energy 'performance indicators' here are LEED-derived qualitative sustainability criteria evaluated by a 16-expert interview survey (min-max normalised Likert scores) that ranks renewable-energy options and criteria for buildings in Iran. No EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised: no energy baseline, relevant variables, functional form, or estimation approach. 'Measurement and verification', 'minimum/optimize energy performance' and 'baseline parameters' appear only incidentally as criteria labels. Application context is buildings (non-industrial).

paper_type.evidence_quote: These criteria contain 53 key elements grouped into 8 major areas as shown in Table

stage1.notes: Tier-1 borderline for human: title says 'energy performance indicators' but paper is a qualitative sustainable-building criteria framework + expert-survey ranking, no EnPI/EnB model. Not review/synthesis. Non-continuous-process (buildings). Flag eligibility and paper_type.
